mode.title: Run mode
mode.description: fixture = push the bundled sample-results.json (for local testing, no network). scrape = look each company up live on krak.dk.

companies.title: Companies to look up
companies.description: Companies to find a phone/contact for. Each: { id, name, city }. Max 100 per run.

maxItems.title: Max companies per run
maxItems.description: Hard cap (Krak is rate-limited; the Actor waits 2s between companies).

webhookUrl.title: Sbotter webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Where to POST results. Falls back to the SBOTTER_WEBHOOK_URL env var if omitted.

webhookSecret.title: Sbotter webhook secret
webhookSecret.description: HMAC-SHA256 key used to sign the result payload. Falls back to the SBOTTER_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var if omitted.
